rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for a numbered technology or cultural version and for a generation as a time span.

example.english: This phone is from the fifth generation, and it is much faster.
example.traditional: 呢部手機係第五代，速度快好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai6 dai6 ng5 doi6 cuk1 dou6 faai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the people who make up a family or age generation, rather than to its number or time span.

example.english: Our generation did not have mobile phones when we were young.
example.traditional: 我哋一代人細個嗰陣冇手機用。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 doi6 jan4 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 mou5 sau2 gei1 jung6
